title: Pairwise comparison report v1
description: The `--output` of `eval score pairwise` (and its `.md` sidecar): each arm's answer judged against the baseline arm's, in both orders; a verdict counts only when both orders agree. `judge_temperature` is added by the command.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

judge_temperature.description: The sampling temperature the judge ran at; added by the command.

summary.description: The judge, the baseline arm, and the win, tie and loss counts per arm.

errors.description: The comparisons that failed, with the reason.
